name: Adaptation Fidelity Control
description: Declarative preset for what must be preserved versus what may change. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Declare sacred facts, compressible texture, and human-review requirements.
writing_goals: List sacred facts, relationships, and ending conditions
Record risks of a change to later continuity
constraints: Do not claim the host will generate a screenplay in this pack
Do not imitate a living screenwriter's voice
checklist: Human review is required before any future application

must_preserve.intent: Facts or turns that survive adaptation.

may_change.intent: Texture that can move or drop.
